data.one_liner: A PageView builder wrapper enabling infinite scrolling in both directions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a LoopPageView widget and LoopPageController that allow for endless scrolling in both directions. Supports direct animated jumps between pages, custom scroll directions, and configurable looping behavior.
use_when: You need an infinite scrolling PageView in Flutter
You require bi-directional looping with custom start activation modes
You want to jump to pages without building intermediate pages
avoid_when: You need standard non-looping PageView features without extra customization
You are not using the flutter SDK
strengths: Supports endless scrolling in both directions
Configurable scrolling modes (shortest, forwards, backwards) and loop activation modes
weaknesses: Requires a specific LoopPageController instead of a standard PageController
